primaryFamily: 26 predeclared phase-metric slots per benchmark scenario (13 metrics x clean and dirty phases); Holm correction is per scenario
pairedBlockMethod: two-sided exact randomization test over all independent equiprobable block-order assignments, using block log-ratios
exactBudgetRule: A regression is any candidate run median above the baseline run-median median or any raw candidate-round maximum above the retained baseline raw-round maximum; report both findings separately
qualificationNote: This policy is a proposed migration contract. approvedJudgeSha256 is a review target, not an approval. A trusted versioned base policy and independent policy review/qualification are required before a candidate may pass the migrated gate.
